book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 KORIN Korin mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge amboŋga kuyarna

content: Yabri mbara atraukade ndem tuku pasa

Afu naŋgine yabri mbara atraukade ndem tuku ye kusnayinaig ta teŋenmba lafuwamŋgit. Sine kila ŋak ŋga sakade ta son ta tane sine kila ŋak mineg ŋga taŋgine ŋgaro payamkade. Tane kume pur maŋaumbi ndo taŋgo saŋgri pileniŋgam kumuŋ.
Ande nu ye kila ŋak minet ŋgate ta nu kila kumumbi te ndakate. Nu denkate.
Ande nu Kuate tuku kume purte ta Kuate nu taŋgo ta kila minit.
Yabri mbara atraukade ndem nyam tuku sakinaig ta teŋenmba. Nane naŋgine mbara kanunu atraukade ta tugusek kuga. Mbara ndindo ndo minit.
Nane afu mbara kame samba mbolŋge kilke mbolŋge mine likade ŋga sakade ta mbara taŋaŋ gudommba minig ta nane katesek mbara kuga.

Siŋgine Mam Kuate nu siŋgine Mbara Ndindo. Ande mine ndakate. Agaŋ ndende ŋakmba nu tugu. Sine nu tuku ndo mineg. Yesus Kristus nu siŋgine Suŋgo ndindo. Nu agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kile-mayokkina. Sine nu mbolŋge abo kitek teg.
Kristus tuku mbal afu wam ta kila pile maye ndade. Nane buk yabri mbara ta dubikinaig tukunu kile yabri mbara atraukade ndem ta nyumba wamdus gisleknu ŋak minmba nyade sulumba mbareg ŋga kutur tade.
Sine agaŋ pileŋga nyeg ta mbolŋge Kuate tugum kine ndakeg. Sine agaŋ afu nda nyeg ta mbolŋge den ndakate. Ko agaŋ afu nyeg ta mbolŋge kumumbi mayok nda kineg.
Sine tukul kugatok ndem ŋakmba nyam kumuŋ ta sine riroŋkube. Tira wamdus gisleknu ta bariŋgikat.
Ne taŋgo kila ŋak mbara atraukam tuku wandekŋge ndem nyumba mina le naŋe tira wamdus gisleknu ne kaŋgernumba saŋgri tiŋga nu mata mbara atraukanu ndem nyumba bariŋgikat.
Ne naŋe kila mayenu tambi tira naŋe ŋayo silite. Ne kurauka. Kristus nu tira ta tuku mata kumna.
Naŋe tira kame wamdus gisleknu minig le ne nane bariŋgam tuku ndin wakeite ta ne Kristus mata ŋayo silite.
Yiŋe tira ande ndem mbolŋge wamdus bariŋguwa ta ye ndem nduiye mbulmba nye nda.
